productsSection.description: Explore our carefully selected collection of herbs, botanical oils, and natural extracts inspired by traditional wellness and everyday self-care.

horsetailSpray.title: Horsetail Spray
horsetailSpray.description: Herbal water-based spray enriched with natural extracts for daily hair care.
horsetailSpray.fullDescription: Horsetail Spray is a unique water-based extract enriched with powerful natural herbs that nourish hair from roots to tips, helping to maintain a healthy look and full appearance.
horsetailSpray.howToUse: Spray directly onto hair and scalp, massage gently. Use daily for best results.

sulfateFreeShampoo.title: Natural Sulfate-Free Shampoo
sulfateFreeShampoo.description: Gentle herbal shampoo that cleanses without stripping natural oils.
sulfateFreeShampoo.fullDescription: An innovative shampoo completely free from sulfates, parabens, and silicones. Gently cleanses the scalp without causing dryness, leaving your hair looking healthy and naturally vibrant.
sulfateFreeShampoo.howToUse: Apply an appropriate amount to wet hair, gently massage the scalp into a light lather, then rinse thoroughly with water.

antimonyOil.title: Natural Antimony Oil
antimonyOil.description: Rich oil formula designed to nourish the scalp and enhance hair thickness.
antimonyOil.fullDescription: A unique blend of Antimony Oil and Amla Oil that penetrates the scalp to nourish roots, support a fuller look, enhance hair density, and protect split ends.
antimonyOil.howToUse: Apply a few drops directly to the scalp and massage gently for 5 minutes. Leave on for a few hours before washing.

stylingCream.title: Natural Hair Styling Cream
stylingCream.description: Nourishing cream with shea butter and natural oils for styling and hydration.
stylingCream.fullDescription: A styling cream enriched with a blend of Shea Butter, Coconut Oil, Argan Oil, Silk Protein, and Panthenol B5. Provides deep hydration and easy styling while leaving hair with a natural shine and healthy look without weighing it down.
stylingCream.howToUse: Apply a suitable amount onto hands and distribute evenly through damp or dry hair from mid-lengths to ends, then style as desired.

hairBalm.title: Natural Herbal & Shea Butter Hair Balm
hairBalm.description: Deeply nourishing balm that leaves hair silky and tangle-free.
hairBalm.fullDescription: A rich nourishing formula made with natural herbal extracts, pure Aloe Vera, organic Shea Butter, Silk Protein, and Argan Oil. Coats the hair shaft to provide intense hydration, protecting it from dryness while adding visible softness and shine.
hairBalm.howToUse: Apply to hair lengths and ends after shampooing, leave for 2-3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with water.

spirulina.title: Natural Spirulina Capsules
spirulina.description: Natural dietary supplement rich in proteins and vitamins for daily vitality.
spirulina.fullDescription: Capsules containing blue-green Spirulina algae, a superfood rich in plant proteins, antioxidants, minerals, and vitamins. Helps boost daily energy levels and supports a balanced healthy lifestyle.
spirulina.howToUse: Take 2 capsules daily with meals or as advised by a nutritionist, with plenty of water.

indianCostus.title: Indian Costus Capsules
indianCostus.description: Pure herbal capsules to support general wellness and natural balance.
indianCostus.fullDescription: Premium capsules containing 100% pure natural Indian Costus. A traditional herbal supplement known for supporting overall wellness, natural body balance, and overall vitality.
indianCostus.howToUse: Take 1 to 2 capsules daily after meals with a glass of water.

herbalCream.title: Camel Hump Herbal Massage Cream
herbalCream.description: Topical massage cream to smooth, firm, and improve skin appearance.
herbalCream.fullDescription: A rich massage formula blending natural camel hump fat with aromatic herbal extracts. Deeply moisturizes the outer skin layers and, with regular massage, helps enhance skin elasticity, firm appearance, and leave a soft texture.
herbalCream.howToUse: Apply a suitable amount to the desired area and massage in circular motions for 10 minutes until fully absorbed. Best used daily.
